name: WHAT NOW? - The Social Experiment Game
detailed_description:
WHAT NOW?
A minimalist social experiment game where the community decides everything.

In WHAT NOW?, you’re not just a player — you’re part of a collective mind. The game evolves based on regular community votes. After each update, a new decision must be made. There is no roadmap — just the will of the players.

Every feature. Every mechanic. Every direction.
Voted. Implemented. Repeated.

🧠 Key Features

🗳 Player-Driven Evolution
Vote directly on what feature should be added or changed next.

🎮 Minimalist UI, Neon Aesthetic
Clean, distraction-free design with dark neon visuals.

🌐 Social Gameplay
Engage with other players through in-game votes, discussions, and collective decisions.

🔄 Ever-Changing Content
No static experience. WHAT NOW? continuously grows and reshapes itself — by design.

❓ Why Play?

This isn’t just a game — it’s a living system, shaped by those who participate. Every vote is a ripple that alters the outcome. Every update is the result of a collective choice.

You don’t just play WHAT NOW?
You create it.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
